brief:
Israeli opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot accused Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of orchestrating a "campaign of delegitimisation" against the country's inconclusive election results, Middle East Eye reported. Eisenkot's statement followed action by the Central Elections Committee regarding the electoral outcome.

The allegations signal deepening political tensions over how Israel's disputed election will be resolved and what role Netanyahu may play in subsequent coalition negotiations.

title: Eisenkot accuses Netanyahu of delegitimizing election results
